contracts.label: Claude Enterprise Analytics
contracts.apiVersion: Claude Enterprise Analytics API current reference; under anthropic-version 2026-10-21 the per-user usage and cost reports rename actor.email to actor.email_address and the activity summaries response renames summaries to data
contracts.auth: Analytics API key with read:analytics created by the Claude Enterprise primary owner; not interchangeable with an Admin API key
contracts.pagination: Cursors are bound to the original filters, grouping and period; changing scope requires restarting from page one
contracts.units: Analytics cost amounts are decimal fractional cents; organization total is authoritative for reported usage credits and per-user rows are attribution only. Product metric objects are always present: an organization without that product's usage sees zero counts, never a null object, while an individual field inside an object can be null, which means the value is not available and must not be read as zero (distinct_skills_used_count in chat_metrics when user activity is filtered by project)
contracts.currency: Post-discount, pre-credit USD fractional cents for reported usage credits; not the contracted Enterprise seat invoice
contracts.window: Explicit ending_at at or before data_refreshed_at; data starts January 1, 2026. Organization cost queries start within the last 365 days and span at most 31 days. When ending_at is omitted it defaults to 31 days after starting_at or the current time, whichever is earlier, and that range can run past data_refreshed_at
contracts.freshnessAndRevision: Cost/usage typically refreshes within four hours and can take up to 24 hours; engagement snapshots lag about one day. The guide permits cost/usage revisions until about seven days after calendar-month end, while endpoint references still describe about 30 days after usage. Preserve provisional status across this documentation discrepancy; data_refreshed_at does not establish finality. The four analytics cost and usage report endpoints are documented as legacy and remain supported, with the Usage and Cost Analytics API (callable with the Analytics API key) as the recommended successor
contracts.reconciliationAnchor: Organization cost report after the applicable documented revision bounds, reconciled separately from the matching Enterprise seat invoice/contract; finality remains provisional while the revision guidance conflicts
exclusions: Credits, tax, contract true-ups and payment settlement

contracts.apiVersion: Current Cursor Admin API reference; no date-version header
contracts.auth: Cursor team Admin API key via HTTP Basic authentication
contracts.pagination: One-indexed page/pageSize; complete all reported pages and prove member/event coverage for the requested scope
contracts.units: Use spendCents/overallSpendCents aggregates and chargedCents event details as provider fields; preserve model, kind, usage pool, Cursor Token Rate context, Max mode and token/cache splits without repricing. Paid plans in the X subscription include one weekly pool of usage for Cursor models, shared with Grok; the two monthly pools, Cursor Models and Other Models, belong only to legacy Cursor plans (Pro, Pro+, Ultra, Start and Teams Standard/Premium seats)
contracts.currency: Provider cents divided by 100; the implemented spend aggregate remains estimated until a separate same-cycle dashboard/invoice check. Event-detail reconciliation is a separate target, and bases remain distinct: included usage (the weekly pool, or a legacy plan's Cursor Models and Other Models pools), additional usage (prepaid credit, or on-demand usage on legacy plans) and BYOK
contracts.window: Team spend is the current subscription cycle; filtered events use inclusive epoch-millisecond bounds and hourly aggregation
contracts.freshnessAndRevision: Polling guidance is hourly; incomplete pagination or event/aggregate residual remains partial/missing
contracts.reconciliationAnchor: Sum filtered usage-event chargedCents and reconcile to /teams/spend for the identical current cycle, then compare with invoice/export
exclusions: Undocumented local IDE/CLI stores are not financial evidence
